records.command:
Execute Larry per-account cron (Dais 2026-06-07 spec Part I+T+X).

★ fixed-strings driven flow (NEW). DO NOT use old generate-slides.js. ★

STEP 1 — Read fixed-strings:
  FS=~/.openclaw/skills/anicca-larry/state/fixed-strings-larry-en-v1.json
  (defines slide1_hook, slide7_cta?, bg_mode, bg files; per-account brand)

STEP 2 — Read library + history:
  - ~/.openclaw/state/content-library/pattern-card-en.jsonl
  - ~/.openclaw/state/content-library/account-history.jsonl
    filter for this cron's account, last 14d → forbidden BODY texts
  - Pick 1 viral pattern with high views, source_id NOT in 14d, emotion diversity

STEP 3 — Generate 5 fresh BODY texts (slide 2-6) ONLY in en:
  Clone pattern STRUCTURE + emotion (clone-don't-template). Fresh wording.
  Write picks.json:
    [body1, body2, body3, body4, body5]
  Write source_id.txt + emotion.txt for append-to-history.

STEP 4 — Build slides (NEW helper):
  RUN_DIR="$HOME/.openclaw/workspace/tiktok-marketing/run-larry-en-v1-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M)"
  mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
  cp picks.json "$RUN_DIR/picks.json"  # body texts only
  bash ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/larry/scripts/build-from-fixed-strings.sh \
    "$FS" "$RUN_DIR/picks.json" "$RUN_DIR"

STEP 5 — Post to TikTok via post-to-tiktok.js (SSOT for DIRECT_POST + PUBLIC + autoAddMusic):
  node ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/larry/scripts/post-to-tiktok.js \
    --tt cmlt171eq04d9r00yzzceb6bw --dir "$RUN_DIR" \
    --caption "<5-8 word caption derived from hook+body>" \
    --title "<account-appropriate title>"

STEP 6 — Append history:
  bash ~/.openclaw/skills/_shared/append-to-history.sh \
    --account larry-anicca-en-1 --platform TT --post-id <TT_POST_ID> \
    --source-id "$(cat $RUN_DIR/source_id.txt)" \
    --hook "$(python3 -c \"import json; print(json.load(open('$FS'))['slide1_hook'])\")" \
    --emotion "$(cat $RUN_DIR/emotion.txt)"

Report TT_POST_ID + source_id used.

   ~/.openclaw/workspace/tiktok-marketing/slots/morning-ja.json
